name: exchange-api

dependencies.name: thunder-app
dependencies.description: Validates the bearer token on incoming requests (via the gateway) to identify the signed-in caller.

dependencies.name: exchange-rate-provider
dependencies.description: Frankfurter (api.frankfurter.dev) — free, keyless, daily-refreshed exchange rate data covering 200+ currencies, used to fetch each currency's current rate against USD. No API key or config needed; requires a specPath before the build gate resolves it.

description: Ballerina REST service that lists supported currencies and returns the current exchange rate of a given currency to USD, sourced daily from an external exchange-rate provider. Sits behind the gateway (bearer-token protected) and is called only by exchange-webapp. Does not perform arbitrary amount conversion, history, or store per-user data.
